code='''def transform(grid):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[[1 if grid[r][c]==8 else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    if len(marks)<2: return [[8*x for x in row] for row in shape]
    dr=marks[1][0]-marks[0][0]; dc=marks[1][1]-marks[0][1]
    # Replicate perpendicular to the marker axis.
    sr,sc=dc,-dr
    h,w=len(shape),len(shape[0]); minr=min(0,sr); minc=min(0,sc)
    H=h+abs(sr); W=w+abs(sc); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for ar,ac in ((0,0),(sr,sc)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if shape[r][c]: out[ar-minr+r][ac-minc+c]=8
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
